rv.q: In Pursuit Of is as timely as it is ageless, a cautionary tale wrapped in a message of redemption.
Ultimately, In Pursuit Of is a world premiere worth seeing in Chicago and a production that invites meaningful conversation about the social issues it explores.
This particular play, directed by Nole Beran, is loosely based on "Crime & Punishment ( at least the concept), but is a little bit harder to follow.

cn.t: This modern adaptation of Crime and Punishment earns mostly positive reviews for translating Dostoevsky's themes to contemporary Chicago, though reception is mixed on execution, with critics praising its emotional resonance and timely questions about morality.
